rules.statement: Keep a type's XML doc summary from restating its only member's summary: give the class a one-line summary of its purpose and put the detail in the method summary and parameter docs.
rules.why: Duplicate summaries drift apart when one is edited, and readers waste time on the repetition.
rules.check: Look at new or changed classes whose `<summary>` says nearly the same thing as the summary of the method they contain, such as a single-method helper.

rules.statement: Don't ask for a static helper to become an injectable service when it is a pure function of its arguments, it builds on sibling helpers that are also static, and the injected dependencies it uses (such as a logger) come from the caller, for example through a delegate.
rules.why: Static is intended in that case: callers' tests still check behavior through their own mocked dependencies, so turning the helper into a service adds nothing to testability.
rules.check: Before reporting a static class against the prefer-injectable-services rule, check whether it holds state or does I/O itself, whether the neighbouring helpers it calls are static, and whether side effects go through dependencies the caller passes in that tests can mock.
